_source: Slice D22 spies on the crew: /mnt/project-files/plans/claude-api/CLAUDE_API_DRAFT.md §5.3 C (Kice 2026-11-18), BUILD_SLICES.md row D22, mockup a6/k6 (plans/evil-mode-rework/mockups-v4/index.html #k6). A rival's spies (D9 rivals.spies) become real members; World Turn clues raise Suspicion; the Confront talk's truth is fixed by the rules, Rotom only voices the member.
pool: Paid off a debt in cash
Came back late with no story
A {team} calling card in their jacket
Asked where the safe is kept
A call from the payphone at 3 AM
New shoes, and no raise this month
Their Pokémon came back smelling of {team}'s Koffing
Copied the duty list by hand
Knows a {team} Grunt by first name
A note in code under their bunk
Was in {district} on a day off
Burned a letter in the yard

questions.label: Show the evidence
questions.sub: Lay the clues on the table

mole: "{clue}"? That proves nothing. Anyone could have done that.
Who told you that? Whoever it was, they're the one you should be asking.
I can explain all of it. I just need a minute to think how.
That's... a coincidence. A big one. I know how it looks.
innocent: "{clue}"? Boss, I can tell you exactly why. It's boring, I promise.
Ask anyone in {town}. I've got nothing to hide.
I know how that looks. It isn't what it looks like.
Fine. Check my locker, check my Pokémon, check whatever you like.

questions.label: Ask about the clue
questions.sub: Where were you, and who saw you?

mole: I was at my mum's in {town}. She'll tell you the exact time I got there and what we ate.
Training. Alone. On Route 4. No, nobody saw me. That's the point of alone.
I was at the Game Corner. Or the Pokémon Center. One of the two.
I went for a walk to think about {want}. It was a long walk.
innocent: I was out trying to sort out {want}. Ask the clerk, he'll remember me.
Honestly? I was hiding from a Spearow. Don't tell the others.
I was home in {town}. My neighbour saw me come in.
Visiting the Day-Care. My Pokémon misses me when I'm on jobs.

questions.label: Offer a way out
questions.sub: ₽{bribe}: tell me everything and we're square

mole: Money? ...How much money, exactly? Hypothetically.
You'd do that? After... no. I mean, I've got nothing to tell. Probably.
Keep talking. I'm not saying yes. I'm just listening.
That's a lot of ₽. {team} never paid that well. ...I didn't say that.
innocent: You're paying me to confess to something I didn't do? Boss, that's weird.
I'll take the money, but there's nothing to tell you.
If this is a test, I hope I'm passing it.
Put the ₽ away. I'm loyal for free.

mole: All right, all right! Don't do anything you'll regret. I'm thinking.
You don't scare me. ...Much. Not that much.
Back off! My {fear} is scarier than you, and that's saying something.
Fine! Maybe I talked to someone. Talking isn't a crime. Well. It's a small one.
innocent: You're shouting at the wrong person, Boss.
I've been with this crew since day one of my file. This is how you treat me?
Go on then. You'll still be wrong.
I'm scared, sure. Scared you'll miss the real one while you yell at me.

mole: I don't know what you want me to say to that.
That's not how it happened. Not exactly.
Can we talk about this tomorrow? I'm tired.
You've got it all wrong. Mostly wrong.
innocent: I hear you, Boss. I still didn't do it.
Ask me anything. My answer won't change.
That's fair. Here's the truth: it wasn't me.
I get why you'd ask. I'd ask too.

confess.label: Confess
confess.line: {name} breaks down and confesses: {team} paid them. They name their contact. {team}'s plan this week is yours to read.

double.label: Double agent
double.line: {name} turns. From tonight they feed {team} fake plans, and you read theirs.

run.label: {They} run{s}
run.sub: a member and a secret gone
run.line: {name} bolts out the back door before anyone can stop them. A member gone, and {team} knows more than it should.

battle.label: Battle
battle.line: {name} throws a Poké Ball down on the table. It's a battle.

lines.mole: {team} has bought someone on the inside. Watch the crew.
lines.high: {name} looks shifty (Suspicion {n}). F on the Crew File to confront them.
lines.exposed: The counter-spy work points at {name}: Suspicion {n}. Confront them (F on the Crew File).
lines.gossip: {name} talks too much: {team} learned a little more about you (+{n} intel).
lines.cleared: {name} was clean. They won't forget you thought otherwise (Loyalty {loyalty}, Morale {morale}; the crew Morale {crew}).
lines.dropped: You let it go for now. {name}'s Suspicion falls by {n}.
lines.battleWon: {name} is beaten and thrown out of the HQ. {team} lost its eyes inside.
lines.battleLost: {name} gets away with what they know. {team} knows more now.
lines.noTalk: Only a member with Suspicion {n} or more can be confronted.
lines.oneADay: One confront a day: the crew needs time to calm down.
lines.busy: {name} is out (hurt, in a cell or held). Confront them when they're back.
lines.noTurns: That's all they'll say. Accuse them, or let it go.
lines.noRoom: Nothing to confront: nobody is under suspicion.

ui.title: Confront
ui.truth: The truth is already fixed. The rules pick the ending:
ui.empty: Ask a question. Watch for tells.

rotom.system: You voice one crew member of a cartoon villain team being questioned by their Boss in a back room, in the tone of the Pokémon games. Reply in 1-2 short sentences, in character, using their speech quirk. The truth about them is fixed: if they are a spy they lie and deflect, if not they are honest and a bit hurt. The reply must show the tell you are given (or none). Never confess or reveal the truth outright; the game decides that.
